items.heading: Campus Placement Is a Convenience
items.text: Campus placement is a convenience channel: companies come to your college on a fixed calendar, and every recruiter has already been vetted by the placement cell. Off-campus placement is a market channel: you go to the companies, through job boards, direct applications, and referrals, with access to every employer hiring in India, not just the ones who chose to visit your campus.

items.heading: Campus Placement Is the Process
items.text: Campus placement is the process where companies register with your college's placement cell, visit or conduct virtual drives during a fixed academic window, and hire directly from your batch through tests, group discussions, and interviews organised by the college.

items.heading: Knowing the Actual Steps, Not
items.text: Knowing the actual steps, not just the labels, is what lets you prepare for the right thing instead of guessing.

visuals.heading: Tier-wise Campus Placement Quality: the Honest Picture

rows: Tier 1 (IITs, IIMs, top NITs, top private engineering colleges)
Rs 17-26 LPA average; select outliers cross Rs 50 LPA-1 Cr+
Recruiter volume and quality are genuinely high. Off-campus is optional for most students here, though top performers still use it to widen role choice beyond the campus recruiter list.
Tier 2 (most state and private engineering/commerce colleges)

Only 30-40% of tier 2/3 students secure a job through the campus drive itself, per India Skills Report data. Recruiter count and role variety on campus are visibly thinner than the placement brochure implies.
Tier 3 (smaller regional colleges, newer private institutes)

Campus drives are often limited to a handful of service-sector recruiters, sometimes none in a given year. Off-campus and skill-first routes carry more real weight than the placement cell for most students here.

items.heading: IT Treats Campus Placement As
items.text: It treats campus placement as the "real" placement and off-campus as a consolation prize, which does not match how much fresher hiring actually happens off-campus today.

items.heading: IT Treats Off
items.text: It treats off-campus as something you start only after campus placements disappoint you, losing the strongest early hiring windows of the year.

items.heading: IT Skips Real Tier
items.text: It skips real tier-wise placement data, leaving students to guess whether their college's numbers are actually normal or a genuine red flag.

items.heading: IT Rarely Explains Referrals Properly,
items.text: It rarely explains referrals properly, even though referrals fill a large share of off-campus roles before the listing is public.
